tests.title: Core Tool declares ReachableTools and Terminating flags
given: a core.Tool definition with ReachableTools and Terminating fields populated
tests.when: a tool is instantiated with child tools and terminating flag
then: ReachableTools holds the child tool slice
Terminating boolean flag is true on the parent tool

tests.title: ToolWire excludes ReachableTools and Terminating from provider payloads
given: a core.Tool with ReachableTools populated and Terminating set to true
tests.when: ToolWire or ToolWires is converted from a wrapper tool
then: ToolWire and ToolWires output contains only Name, Description, InputSchema, and ConstrainedSampling
ReachableTools and Terminating fields are excluded from wire representation
tests.pseudocode:
child = core.Tool{Name: "child", Handler: h}
t = core.Tool{Name: "wrapper", Description: "wrapper tool", InputSchema: s, ReachableTools: []core.Tool{child}, Terminating: true}
wire = core.ToolWire(t)
jsonBytes, _ := json.Marshal(wire)
var m map[string]any
json.Unmarshal(jsonBytes, &m)
assert _, ok := m["ReachableTools"]; !ok
assert _, ok := m["reachable_tools"]; !ok
assert _, ok := m["Terminating"]; !ok
assert _, ok := m["terminating"]; !ok

tests.title: Cycle detection rejects cyclic reachability hierarchies in agent creation and tool registration
given: tools configured with direct or transitive reachability cycles (e.g. A -> B -> A)
tests.when: NewAgent, NewAgentWithHistory, or RegisterTool is called with cyclic reachable tools
then: NewAgent, NewAgentWithHistory, and RegisterTool reject the configuration
the error message matches 'agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected: <path>'
tests.pseudocode:
var toolA, toolB core.Tool
toolA = core.Tool{Name: "toolA", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolB}}
toolB = core.Tool{Name: "toolB", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolA}}
toolA.ReachableTools[0] = toolB
_, err := NewAgent(cfg, toolA)
assert err != nil
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected: toolA -> toolB -> toolA")
ag, _ := NewAgent(cfg)
errReg := ag.RegisterTool(toolA)
assert errReg != nil
assert strings.Contains(errReg.Error(), "agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected:")

tests.title: Terminating tools reachable through wrappers are rejected at registration
given: a wrapper tool declaring a child tool that has Terminating set to true
tests.when: agent construction or tool registration encounters a wrapper reaching a terminating tool
then: NewAgent, NewAgentWithHistory, and RegisterTool return an error
the error is formatted as 'agentkit: terminating tool "<terminating>" cannot be reached through wrapper "<wrapper>"'
tests.pseudocode:
term = core.Tool{Name: "finish", Terminating: true, Handler: h}
wrap = core.Tool{Name: "code_mode", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{term}, Handler: h}
_, err := NewAgent(cfg, wrap)
assert err != nil
expected := `agentkit: terminating tool "finish" cannot be reached through wrapper "code_mode"`
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), expected)
ag, _ := NewAgent(cfg)
errReg := ag.RegisterTool(wrap)
assert errReg != nil
assert strings.Contains(errReg.Error(), expected)

for diamond in gen_diamond_hierarchies():

tests.title: Context cancellation aborts nested calls with aborted error outcome
given: a context that is cancelled while nested tool calls are executing
tests.when: the context is cancelled during nested tool execution
then: in-flight nested calls abort and return ToolResult{OK: false, Error: 'aborted', Detail: 'Operation aborted'}
tests.pseudocode:
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
slowTool := core.Tool{Name: "slow", Handler: func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (core.ToolResult, error) {
    <-ctx.Done()
    return core.ToolResult{OK: false, Error: "aborted", Detail: "Operation aborted"}, nil
}}
go func() { time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
results, _ := core.CallNested(ctx, core.ToolUseBlock{ID: "c1", Name: "slow"})
assert len(results) == 1
assert results[0].OK == false
assert results[0].Error == "aborted"
assert results[0].Detail == "Operation aborted"

tests.title: Turn stop policies evaluate only top-level tool calls and ignore nested tool calls

tests.when: stop.WhenToolCalled is evaluated at the end of a turn containing nested tool calls
then: turn stop policies ignore nested tool calls and evaluate exclusively against top-level tool calls

stopPolicy := stop.WhenToolCalled("child_tool")
ag := createAgentWithStopPolicy(stopPolicy)
ag.RunMessage(ctx, "run wrapper tool that calls child_tool")
assert ag.Idle()
assert ag.StopReason() != core.StopReasonToolCalled, "stop policy must ignore nested child_tool calls"

tests.title: Smoke test for cycle detection rejection at agent construction

then: agent initialization is refused

tests.pseudocode:
var toolA, toolB core.Tool
toolA = core.Tool{Name: "toolA", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolB}, Handler: noopHandler}
toolB = core.Tool{Name: "toolB", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{toolA}, Handler: noopHandler}
toolA.ReachableTools[0] = toolB
_, err := NewAgent(AgentConfig{}, toolA)
assert err != nil
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), "agentkit: reachable tools cycle detected: toolA -> toolB -> toolA")

tests.title: Smoke test for unguarded shell tool detection across reachable tool wrappers
given: an agent configured without BeforeToolCall where a wrapper tool reaches a shell tool
tests.when: ag.Run is invoked on an agent with an unguarded reachable shell tool
then: agent run aborts before making provider requests
error wraps core.ErrUnguardedExecute naming wrapper and shell tool
tests.pseudocode:
shellTool := core.Tool{Name: "execute", Handler: noopHandler}
wrapper := core.Tool{Name: "code_mode", ReachableTools: []core.Tool{shellTool}, Handler: noopHandler}
ag, _ := NewAgent(AgentConfig{BeforeToolCall: nil}, wrapper)
_, err := ag.RunMessage(ctx, "run script")
assert err != nil
assert errors.Is(err, core.ErrUnguardedExecute)
assert strings.Contains(err.Error(), `wrapper "code_mode" reached shell tool "execute"`)
